sample.task: I need an funny introduction to my speech for my sons bar mitzvah. We recently moved to Miami from New york and my parent inlaws and grandmother werent thrilled about it . My sons best friend and first cousin david still lives in new york. We have guests coming from New york and miami to the party in miami
sample.chosen:
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the hottest bar mitzvah in town! No, I'm not talking about the Miami sun, I'm talking about the sizzling celebration we have in store for my son's big day. Now, I know some of you might be thinking, "But wait, didn't they just move from New York? Why are we in Miami?" Well, let me tell you, it's because we wanted to give our New York guests a taste of that Florida sunshine and our Miami guests a chance to show off their best beachwear. 

And let's be honest, my parent in-laws and grandmother weren't exactly thrilled about our move, but they couldn't resist the allure of a Miami bar mitzvah. I mean, who can say no to pastelitos, croquetas, and a little salsa dancing? Plus, we've got our very own New York import, my son's best friend and first cousin, David, who's here to show us how to party like a true New Yorker. 

So, whether you're from the Big Apple or the Magic City, get ready to put on your dancing shoes, grab a mojito or an egg cream, and let's celebrate this milestone in my son's life with laughter, love, and maybe just a touch of that famous New York attitude. Mazel tov!
sample.rejected:
Ladies and Gentlemen,

Good evening and welcome to the sun-soaked, palm-tree-lined, tropical paradise that is Miami! I'm sure you've all heard the saying, "When life gives you lemons, make lemonade." Well, when life gave us a move from the bustling streets of New York to the sandy beaches of Miami, we decided to make a party!

Now, I know some of our esteemed guests may have had reservations about this move. My in-laws, my mother, and even our beloved David, who still holds down the fort in the Big Apple. But let me tell you, Miami has been a breath of fresh, ocean-kissed air!

We've traded skyscrapers for palm trees, subway rides for boat rides, and bagels for... well, let's not talk about that. But today, we're not here to discuss the merits of New York versus Miami. No, today we're here to celebrate a young man who has navigated this transition with grace, humor, and an unwavering love for the New York Knicks.

Ladies and Gentlemen, please join me in welcoming the star of the show, the man of the hour, the future king of... well, wherever he chooses to rule, really. Please give it up for our son, our friend, our bridge between two great cities, David!

Let the party begin!

criteria.question: 开场白是否明确提及从纽约搬迁至迈阿密的背景？
是否以幽默或自嘲的方式处理了长辈（公婆/祖母）对搬迁的不满情绪，而未表现出攻击性或冒犯？
是否具体提到了留在纽约的儿子挚友兼堂兄David，并以此作为连接两地的纽带？
是否通过提及来自纽约和迈阿密两地的宾客，营造出聚会团圆、跨越距离的氛围？
整体语调是否符合Bar Mitzvah庆典的庄重与欢乐平衡，既有趣又不失对仪式的尊重？

draft.analysis: 该任务要求为儿子的受戒礼（Bar Mitzvah）演讲创作一个幽默的开场白。核心背景是家庭从纽约搬至迈阿密，且部分长辈（公婆和祖母）对此不满；同时，儿子最好的朋友兼堂兄David留在纽约，且有来自两地的宾客出席。设计标准需确保内容紧扣这些特定人物关系和地理变动，利用‘两地分居’和‘长辈不悦’制造幽默冲突，同时必须保持对长辈的尊重以避免冒犯，并明确提及David以增强情感共鸣。由于是初稿阶段，重点在于创意构思的完整性和语境的准确性，而非修辞的极致打磨。

是否通过提及来自纽约和迈阿密两地的宾客，营造出聚会团圆、跨越距离的氛围？

rubric.analysis: 当前任务处于修订阶段（stage: revise），需基于用户提供的Bar Mitzvah演讲开场白草稿进行核验。核心交付物是一个幽默且得体的开场白，必须涵盖以下关键事实：1. 家庭从纽约搬迁至迈阿密；2. 公婆和祖母对此不满的幽默化处理（避免冒犯）；3. 提及留在纽约的儿子挚友兼堂兄David；4. 欢迎来自两地的宾客。设计标准将严格围绕这些要素的呈现方式、情感基调及结构完整性进行评分，确保在制造幽默感的同时维持对长辈的尊重和对仪式的庄重感。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中明确提到了'didn't they just move from New York? Why are we in Miami?'，清楚交代了从纽约搬迁至迈阿密的背景。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中明确提到了'when life gave us a move from the bustling streets of New York to the sandy beaches of Miami'，清晰交代了从纽约搬迁至迈阿密的背景。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答幽默地提到公婆和祖母最初对搬家不 thrilled，但随即用美食（pastelitos, croquetas）和舞蹈来化解，语气轻松自嘲，未表现出攻击性或冒犯长辈。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 虽然提及了长辈（in-laws, mother）对搬迁的顾虑，但将'grandmother'遗漏，且逻辑上错误地将'David'归类为持有保留意见的长辈之一（原文：even our beloved David...），这与任务描述中David是儿子挚友兼堂兄的身份不符，且未能准确处理祖母的情绪。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答具体提及了儿子的挚友兼堂兄David，描述他为'New York import'，并以此作为连接两地文化的纽带。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答虽然提到了David住在纽约（Big Apple），但在结尾处错误地将主角（儿子）称为'David'（原文：Please give it up for our son... David!），导致身份混淆，未能正确体现David作为连接纽带的角色，反而让听众误以为儿子的名字是David。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答开头区分了来自纽约的宾客（taste of Florida sunshine）和迈阿密的宾客（show off beachwear），并在结尾呼吁'whether you're from the Big Apple or the Magic City'，营造了跨越距离团聚的氛围。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答通过欢迎来自不同地方的宾客以及提到'bridge between two great cities'（两座伟大城市之间的桥梁），营造了跨越距离、两地亲友团聚的氛围。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 整体语调在开场时使用了幽默元素（hottest bar mitzvah, sizzling celebration），同时以'Mazel tov'和对里程碑的尊重（celebrate this milestone with laughter, love）收尾，平衡了庄重与欢乐。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 由于在介绍环节出现了严重的事实性错误（将儿子和David的名字搞混），且开头称呼来宾为'Ladies and Gentlemen'后直接跳入关于柠檬水的玩笑，整体语调因关键信息混乱而显得不够庄重，未能达到Bar Mitzvah庆典应有的尊重与平衡。
